episodeTitle.en: Gibson Biddle on his DHM product strategy framework, GEM roadmap prioritization framework, 5 Netflix strategy mini case studies, building a personal board of directors, and much more
episodeTitle.zh: 吉布森·比德尔将分享他的DHM产品战略框架、GEM路线图优先级框架、5个Netflix战略迷你案例研究、如何组建个人董事会等诸多内容。

guestBioOfficial.en: Before getting into teaching full-time, Gibson Biddle was VP of Product at Netflix and CPO at Chegg (a textbook rental and homework help company). He now spends his days speaking, writing, and hosting workshops on product leadership, strategy, and culture. There are very few people in the world who’ve worked with, and had an impact on, more product managers.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 在全职教学之前，吉布森·比德尔曾担任Netflix产品副总裁和Chegg（一家教材租赁和作业辅导公司）的首席产品官。他如今致力于通过演讲、写作和主持研讨会来传授产品领导力、战略和文化方面的知识。在全球范围内，极少有人曾与更多产品经理共事并对他们产生过深远影响。

title.en: Gibson Biddle on his DHM product strategy framework, GEM roadmap prioritization framework, 5 Netflix strategy mini case studies, building a personal board of directors, and much more
title.zh: 吉布森·比德尔将分享他的DHM产品战略框架、GEM路线图优先级框架、5个Netflix战略迷你案例研究、如何组建个人董事会等诸多内容。

summary.en: In this conversation, Gibson draws on his experience shaping strategy at Netflix and Chegg to share durable lessons on product leadership and how to build a compelling product vision. He discusses the difference between a product strategy and a product culture, how to make smart bets on features, and why focusing on customer value and a clear roadmap matters more than chasing every new idea. The episode is a masterclass in pragmatic product management for leaders who want to scale both impact and clarity.
summary.zh: 在这期对话中，Gibson 结合在 Netflix 和 Chegg 制定战略的经验，分享了关于产品领导力、以及如何打造有说服力的产品愿景的持久经验。他区分了“产品战略”与“产品文化”，讲解了如何对功能做出明智的押注，以及为何聚焦客户价值与清晰的路线图，比追逐每一个新点子更重要。这期节目是关于务实产品管理的公开课，献给想要同时放大影响力和清晰度的领导者。
